author: Clash sucksssss
title: See this
content:
Clash Royale is a terrible game because it gets boring and frustrating very fast. The game feels like you can lose just because the other player has better cards. It is annoying when you spend time trying to win and then lose because of one stupid move.

The game also has way too many things that make you want to spend money. Getting better cards can take forever unless you spend money. This makes the game feel unfair and annoying.

Another problem is the matchmaking. You can get matched against players with cards that are way stronger than yours. It makes you feel like you never had a chance in the first place.

The game can also be extremely repetitive. You play the same type of matches over and over again. After a while it just feels like doing the same thing with different cards.

Overall Clash Royale is trash because it is frustrating, repetitive, and unfair. It can waste a lot of time while making you more angry than entertained.

author: Pixardude
title: Perfect Gameplay, Bad Everything Else
content:
This is my most opened game. I played it daily for several years when it first came out, took a break, and now it’s a daily again. It’s a well-balanced strategy game and personally a great alternative to social media. The visuals are awesome during the actual gameplay. Two criticisms: there is a missed opportunity with system haptics, it would be cool to feel the phone vibrate as an enemy is destroyed. It seems like low hanging fruit, so -1 star for that. My other complaint is that the interface outside the actual gameplay is so annoying. I don’t do anything clan-related, I don’t care about snippets, or events, or passes, or tapping 50 times to open chests. It’s incredibly annoying, so -2 stars for that. To your credit, I’m sure the negative association with non-gameplay makes users want to stay in the gameplay longer. But it makes the app feel noisy and trashy. You’re better than that. 
Either way I’m going to keep playing.

title: Meta needs rework
content:
Look, Iv been playing since beta and Iv been on the leaderboards consistently. I’m no pro, but I’m playing pretty much at the top of the non-pro skill curve. 
Certain meta strategies have required a rework for years, yet the developers refuse; pandering to their paying player base. 
If you’re not playing a cycle deck you’re not getting on the leaderboard. Period. 
Hog 2.6 and its arbitrarily different variations are seen easily every other match. 
Graveyard cycle is every 3rd match. 
A meta with this little variation at the top is stagnant. 
A game where you either copy/paste one of 5 decks or lose to said decks, not only lacks creativity but becomes terminally monotonous. 
Money is the root of all evil and greed is the root of CR’s incipient downfall.
